title: tc-preview-card
description: A gallery tile: a large preview above a title and a short description, which opens what it previews.

description.description: A line or two under the title

src.description: The preview picture; without it the page's children are the preview

alt.description: What the picture shows; "" when the title says it

fit.description: How the preview fills its frame: "cover", "contain", or "scale" – laid out at `preview-width` and shrunk to fit

previewWidth.description: The width a scaled preview is laid out at, in pixels

badge.description: A short tag at the preview's top right, such as "New"

href.description: Where the card goes; without it the card is a button that fires tc-open

orientation.description: "vertical" puts the preview above the words; "horizontal" beside them, for a list

loading.description: Shows a placeholder while the card's content loads
